assumptions.text: No network or authoritative-document access was available in this session; all property values and standard information were recalled from training knowledge and marked Conditionally verified or Unverified accordingly. Nothing is marked 'Verified' except arithmetic and unit checks.

'Verified' = checked against an authoritative source or independently recalculated; 'Conditionally verified' = consistent with recalled handbook/standard information but not checked against the document; 'Unverified' = cannot be confirmed or under-specified; 'Incorrect' = supplied claim contains an error.
Values labelled Typical are handbook-type figures; values labelled Specified minimum come from product standards and are not guaranteed design allowables.
All property values are room-temperature unless stated; test temperature column supplied.
Specific strength uses UTS if present, otherwise YS; specific stiffness uses E. Shear modulus is derived assuming isotropy.
Hall–Petch, Goodman, Archard and Larson–Miller worked examples use illustrative assumed parameters (labelled) — not fitted to a specific dataset.
Gap-list grades are suggestions and are excluded from coverage counts.
Cost entries are qualitative and unverified.
